smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: LookX
shortDescription: Turns sketches into architectural renders. The monthly plan is $20.
longDescription: LookX turns text and sketches into rendering images and offers plugins for SketchUp and Rhino. You can also train a model on images of a style you want to repeat. The free plan needs no card. The monthly plan is $20 and the annual plan is $199. A team plan for 5 seats is $269.
pricingNotes: The free plan needs no card. Monthly is $20. Annual is $199. A team plan for 5 seats is $269.
bestFor: A sketch that should become an architectural render
A studio that wants a model trained on its own style
notIdealFor: A phone scan that should become a measured floor plan
Virtual staging of an empty listing photo
strength: LookX turns a sketch into an architectural render and can train a custom model on a style you upload.
weakness: The monthly plan is $20, and the public site describes sketch rendering more clearly than a dedicated floor-plan upload.
